marks.gloss_en: עליך אמר קרא: מכל מעשרתיכם תרימו -- another verse obligates the tithe taken from the pile (= p_abaye_mikol_maasroteichem)
ומה ראית? -- what did you see [to apply 'from all your tithes' to the pile and 'a tithe from the tithe' to the stalks]?
האי אידגן והאי לא אידגן -- this has become grain and that has not (= p_abaye_kri_idgan, p_abaye_shibolim_lo_idgan)
Abaye: against you the verse says, 'from all your tithes you shall set apart' (Num 18:29) -- [tithe taken first from the pile owes teruma gedola]
דאמר רבי זירא אמר רבי יוחנן: לעולם אינו גר עד שימול ויטבול, וכמה דלא טבל גוי הוא -- so the circumcised convert who has not immersed is still the mishnah's gentile (a דאמר citation; svara stands in)
the mishnah: and a gentile -- one does not include him in a zimmun
the mishnah: women, slaves and minors -- one does not include them in a zimmun
דתניא: ...וחכמים אומרים כל שאינו מעשר פירותיו כראוי -- the Rabbis who disagree with R' Meir define the am haaretz by tithing
דבמאי דכתיב באורייתא מזהר זהירי -- they tithe properly because they are scrupulous in what is written in the Torah
דאמר מר: כל מצוה שהחזיקו בה כותים הרבה מדקדקין בה יותר מישראל
בכותי חבר -- the mishnah speaks of a Kuti who is a chaver (= p_abaye_kuti_chaver)
אפילו תימא בכותי עם הארץ -- the baraita's am haaretz is the Rabbis' (one who does not tithe properly), and these Kutim tithe properly (= p_rava_am_haaretz_derabbanan, p_kutim_measrim)
Abaye: [the mishnah speaks] of a Kuti who is a chaver
אמאי? לא יהא אלא עם הארץ! ותניא: אין מזמנין על עם הארץ -- why is a Kuti included? let him be no more than an am haaretz, and it was taught that an am haaretz is not included
the mishnah: a Kuti is included in a zimmun
והתניא: אחרים אומרים אפילו קרא ושנה ולא שמש תלמידי חכמים הרי זה עם הארץ -- one who only studied is an am haaretz, whom one does not include
שאני רב מנשיא בר תחליפא דמשמע להו לרבנן, ורמי בר חמא הוא דלא דק אבתריה -- he did serve the Rabbis; Rami bar Chama failed to check (= p_menashya_meshamesh, p_rami_lo_dak)
לישנא אחרינא: דשמע שמעתתא מפומייהו דרבנן וגריס להו -- כצורבא מרבנן דמי (= p_shama_ugares_tzurva)
Rami bar Chama did not include Rav Menashya bar Tachlifa, who studied Sifra, Sifrei and halakhot, in a zimmun
R' Eliezer: an am haaretz is whoever does not recite the Shema evening and morning
the mishnah: one who ate first tithe [whose teruma was not taken] is not included in a zimmun
with what are we dealing here? where he gave the principal and did not give the fifth
כרבי יהושע בן לוי, דאמר: ...עושין אותו סניף לעשרה
הוא דאמר כרבי יהושע בן לוי -- he said it as RYBL, who makes the cradle-minor an adjunct for ten (= p_r_yosei_kerybl)
he [R' Yosei] said it in accordance with R' Yehoshua ben Levi
שנאמר לעולם בהם תעבדו
והיכי עביד הכי? והאמר רב יהודה: כל המשחרר עבדו עובר בעשה -- freeing a slave transgresses a positive command (kind svara under protest: an amoraic-memra contradiction has no kind)
לדבר מצוה שאני -- for a mitzva it is different (= p_ledvar_mitzva_shani)
מצוה הבאה בעבירה היא! -- it is a mitzva that comes through a transgression
מצוה דרבים שאני -- a mitzva of the many is different (= p_mitzva_derabim_shani; it narrows the first answer, which this edge cannot say)
Rav Yehuda: whoever frees his slave transgresses a positive command
תניא נמי הכי: ...ואין מדקדקין בקטן -- the clause that, as the stam then shows, includes the maturing minor
הא גופא קשיא: you said two hairs -- yes, no two hairs -- no, and then it teaches 'one is not exacting with a minor'; to include what?
R' Yochanan: a maturing minor -- a zimmun is formed over him
והא תנן: נשים ועבדים וקטנים אין מזמנין עליהם -- the mishnah excludes minors from a zimmun, and R' Yosei includes a cradle-minor
מיתיבי: R' Eliezer freed his slave to complete the ten -- שחרר אין, לא שחרר לא: an unfreed slave does not join
תרי איצטריכו, שחרר חד ונפיק בחד -- two were needed; he freed one and completed [the count] with the other, unfreed
RYBL: nine and a slave join together
וארון גברא הוא? -- is an ark a man? (unanswered: אלא אמר רב הונא replaces the dictum)
Rav Huna: nine and an ark join together
ושבת גברא הוא?! -- is Shabbat a man? (unanswered: אלא אמר רבי אמי replaces the dictum)
Rav Ami: two and Shabbat join together
RYBL: one should always rise early to the synagogue so as to merit being counted among the first ten

ורחמנא אמר וצרת הכסף בידך -- כסף שיש לו עליו צורה: second tithe must be redeemed on money bearing a form, so redemption on an asimon is not according to law (a verse-derivation; no support kind names ורחמנא אמר, svara stands in)
ולא פדאו בכסף, ורחמנא אמר ונתן הכסף וקם לו -- consecrated property is redeemed with money, so exchanging it for land is not according to law (a verse-derivation; svara stands in)
the mishnah: [one who ate] second tithe [and consecrated food that were not redeemed -- one does not include him in a zimmun]
you might have said: the waiter has not fixed [himself to the meal, so no zimmun is formed over him]
the mishnah: and a waiter who ate less than an olive-bulk -- [one does not include him in a zimmun]
the mishnah: one who ate tevel is not included in a zimmun
